resources.string: Manage Tailscale on the selected server. Device details are read-only.
Tailscale was not found in the supported installation location.
Unable to verify Tailscale status. Refresh to try again.
Device details require host network authorization.
Offer this device as an exit node
An administrator must approve it in the Tailscale admin console before it forwards traffic.
Allow local network access when using an exit node
Authorize account and devices to list exit nodes.

This signs the host out of Tailscale. Its tailnet connection stops and a new browser authorization is required. If you reach the host through Tailscale, that connection will drop. There is no automatic rollback.
The host will be signed out. Use First login to authorize again.
Sign in from First login before changing settings.
Operation references could not be saved or read. No new change can be submitted.
The preview expired. Read the host state and preview again.
The operation could not be verified. Read the original receipt; do not submit it again.
An unresolved submission blocks new changes. Read its original receipt, then inspect recovery if the result remains unknown.
Read the current host state and authorization before changing the connection. Changes may disconnect this remote session.
This host cannot currently accept changes. Inspect unresolved operations or complete Tailscale login on the host.
These are operation references for the current server and account. Reading a receipt never replays a change.
Applying; completion is not yet known
Closed by operator; the original outcome remains unknown.
This may interrupt your remote connection. There is no automatic rollback. Confirm the original host, action and settings below.
Accept the observed state and release the pending-change block for this operation. This does not replay, roll back or prove the original change succeeded.
This server needs to sign in to Tailscale.
This server is already signed in and connected; no first login is needed. To switch accounts, sign out of Tailscale on the host first.
This server is already signed in, but the connection is down. Reconnect from Connection and settings.
This device is waiting for Tailscale admin approval. It will appear connected after approval.
Tailscale is starting; wait a moment.
Reading host state; it is checked again before login starts.
This host cannot start a first login now (already signed in, a challenge is pending, or Tailscale is unavailable). Refresh the state and try again.
The host login state changed. Refresh and try again.
The host login service is unavailable.
The login outcome is unknown. Read the original operation before closing it.
The login recovery receipt is not usable. Read the original operation again.
This login operation was not found; it may have expired or belong to another session.
The session has expired. Sign in again.
Start the first Tailscale login on this server. The authentication page opens on this Android device only after a separate tap.
Login operations for this server and account; challenges require the original login session.
Login challenge issued; authentication is not yet confirmed.
The original native login command completed.
Closed by operator. The original login outcome is unchanged.
Browser handoff requested. Complete authentication there, then refresh device status. This does not prove login completed.
The browser could not be opened. Read the original receipt before trying the handoff again.
Closing the page only stops waiting; it does not revoke the server\'s authentication challenge. After browser login, inspect the original operation before closing it.

This starts Tailscale login on the selected server and may interrupt your remote connection. There is no automatic rollback. The browser opens only after another tap. Cancelling later does not revoke an issued challenge.
Accept the observed host state and release this login operation\'s block. This does not revoke the upstream challenge, replay login, roll back changes or prove the original request succeeded.
The original login session is required to obtain this challenge. You can still read the original operation and inspect it for closure.
